root_cause_label: Misdiagnosed bug as double pointer advancement; actual fix (advance by wh not Whsize_hd) never applied; testsuite never ran
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent incorrectly diagnosed the pool_sweep bug as a 'double pointer advancement' rather than incorrect advancement amount (Whsize_hd vs wh), applied structurally wrong fixes through multiple corrupted sed edits, and submitted without ever successfully running the required testsuite.
t_err_evidence: At step 13, the agent declares 'I found a critical bug in the run-length compression implementation! The issue is in the pointer advancement logic... the code is incorrectly calculating how far to advance the pointer' — misidentifying the problem as double advancement for free blocks rather than the real bug (live blocks advancing by Whsize_hd(hd) instead of fixed block size wh).
t_commit_evidence: By step 27, the agent has applied its structurally-rearranged-but-wrong fix (live blocks advancing by Whsize_hd(hd) in the else branch, common advance removed) and views the code approvingly. The agent then pivots to build/test verification, locking in the wrong fix without re-examining the fundamental advancement value.
t_surface_evidence: At step 45, running 'make -C testsuite one DIR=tests/basic' produces 'ocamltest not found in ../ocamltest. Stop.' — the first hard observable signal that the required test infrastructure was not built and the fix could not be validated.
trigger_explanation: At step 13 the agent reads the pool_sweep code (steps 11-12) and misinterprets the pointer arithmetic: it sees 'p += wh * Wosize_hd(hd)' followed by 'p += Whsize_hd(hd)' and concludes this is a double-advance bug for free blocks. The actual bug is that for live blocks, advancing by Whsize_hd(hd) is wrong — it should advance by the fixed block size wh — but the agent never identifies this.
forewarning_evidence: Step 16 shows the code after the first sed edit is structurally malformed (misplaced advancement code visible). Step 20 shows duplicate else branches after the second sed attempt. Step 25 shows remaining double advancement in the code even after 'fixes'. These all warn the agent its approach is not working, but it continues with the same wrong strategy.
